footer.tagline: One organization. One context. All of your team's work.
f.prod.title: All of your team's work, in one shared context.
f.prod.body: One identity, one set of access rules, one audit trail. Start with Space and Desk at launch; Doc, Chat and App Center follow in the same workspace.
f.desk.name: Desk
f.desk.title: Start the day in one place.
f.desk.body: Desk gathers what you need to follow up on from every project. The inbox only holds what concerns you, not every change.
f.desk.c1: Inbox: mentions, assignments and due dates coming up
f.desk.c2: My tasks grouped by due date, from every space
f.desk.c3: Email only for what matters: account and billing
f.desk.mock: agere/org Desk: the inbox with a mention, an assignment and a due date, then today's tasks with one marked done
f.doc.name: Doc
f.doc.title: Team knowledge, right next to the work.
f.doc.body: Write PRDs, meeting notes and SOPs in the same project as their tasks. Docs are always editable and save on their own.
f.doc.c1: Folders to organise Docs by team or topic
f.doc.c2: Import Markdown and text, export to PDF and DOCX
f.doc.c3: Access follows the space and the project
f.doc.mock: agere/org Doc: two people editing a PRD, the slash menu adding a checklist, and the document saved
f.chat.name: Chat
f.chat.title: Important discussions don't get lost in a group chat.
f.chat.body: Every project has its own channel, with the same access as the project. A message that holds work can become a task right away.
f.chat.c1: Channels per project and per team, plus direct messages
f.chat.c2: Turn a message into a task, with a link back to where it came from
f.chat.c3: Attachments, reactions, editing and deleting messages
f.chat.mock: agere/org Chat: a project channel where a message becomes a task assigned to Dimas
f.apps.name: App Center
f.apps.title: Connect the tools your team already uses.
f.apps.body: Connect apps directly with OAuth, with no paid middleman. What shows in agere/org always follows access to the task, not to the app.
f.apps.c1: GitHub: pull requests linked to tasks, and the status moves with them
f.apps.c2: Google Drive: attach the files you pick to a task
f.apps.c3: Workspace connections by an Owner or Admin, personal ones by each member
f.apps.mock: agere/org App Center: GitHub and Google Drive get connected, then a pull request is linked to a task and a file is attached

sc.apps.title: App Center
sc.apps.pr: #42 Sign in with an email code
f.ai.title: Agents do the work. You make the call.
f.ai.body: At launch, AI breaks your goal into tasks that are only created once you approve them. AI Agent and AI Organization follow with the same rules: their access never goes beyond yours, and every change is recorded under the name of the person who approved it.
f.agent.name: AI Agent
f.agent.title: An AI teammate you set up in plain words.
f.agent.body: Write what the agent should do, pick the spaces it may read, then delegate tasks. The agent shows its steps and evidence, and anything it writes waits for approval.
f.agent.c1: An agent's access is always the overlap with the access of the person using it
f.agent.c2: Permission per capability: Read, Draft, Needs approval or Denied
f.agent.c3: Stop it at any time; finished work stays saved
f.agent.mock: agere/org AI Agent: the Research agent reads a brief, proposes five tasks and Rina approves them, next to the agent's permissions
f.aiorg.name: AI Organization
f.aiorg.title: Set a goal. An AI team plans the work. The decision stays with you.
f.aiorg.body: For a goal that spans several functions, agere/org builds a plan from the projects, tasks and Docs you already have. You review, correct, then approve once for a list of changes you can see.
f.aiorg.c1: The plan labels each step Create, Update, Reuse or Skip, with its evidence
f.aiorg.c2: A free dry run before you approve, without changing any data
f.aiorg.c3: Approval gates hold the next step until you decide
f.aiorg.mock: agere/org AI Organization: you as the owner, the agere coordinator and five agents, with a plan waiting for your review

ctl.title: Control for the Owner. Certainty for the whole team.
ctl.body: The same rules apply to people and AI, checked on the server and recorded in the audit trail.
ctl.access.title: Access per space and project
ctl.access.body: Owner, Admin and Member, plus Open or Restricted spaces on every plan. Access is checked on the server, not just hidden on screen.
ctl.audit.title: A year of audit trail
ctl.audit.body: Every important change is recorded under the person's name, including AI proposals they approved. The audit trail is kept for a rolling year.
ctl.ai.title: AI that keeps no data
ctl.ai.body: We only use model providers that keep no data. Emails and account identities are never sent to a model, and your workspace is never used to train AI.
ctl.data.title: Data in Singapore, and yours
ctl.data.body: Service data is stored in Singapore. We don't sell data or run ad trackers. The Owner can ask for a copy of the data as CSV or JSON.
ctl.downgrade.title: Stop paying without losing data
ctl.downgrade.body: Stopping deletes nothing and opens no wider access. The organization becomes read-only and comes back in full when you return to Team.
ctl.credits.title: Out of credits, work goes on
ctl.credits.body: When AI credits run out, only the AI features stop until the next allowance. Tasks and projects carry on as usual.
ctl.offline.title: Connection drops, your writing is safe
ctl.offline.body: What you're writing is kept in the browser until it's sent, then cleared. Nothing is lost to a weak signal.
ctl.pay.title: Rupiah, QRIS, no auto-debit
ctl.pay.body: Final prices in rupiah. Pay by QRIS, virtual account or card. Renewal invoices are issued 7 days ahead.
ctl.lang.title: Bahasa Indonesia and English
ctl.lang.body: Every member picks their own language. What the team writes is never machine-translated.

doc.coldStart.folder: Everyone in the organization with Doc access can read docs in a folder.
doc.coldStart.private: A doc with no folder and no project is visible only to you.
doc.coldStart.project: A doc linked to a project follows that project's access.
doc.noAccess.title: You don't have access to Doc yet
doc.noAccess.body: Your organization's admin can give you access.
space.pickOne: Choose a space in the panel, or create one.
space.emptyAny: Create a space to group your team's projects.
space.coldStart.title: Start working in Space
space.coldStart.body: Space holds your team's work, from projects to daily tasks.
space.coldStart.space: One team or area of work, such as Marketing. Open to every member or restricted.
space.coldStart.project: Work with one goal, inside a space.
space.coldStart.task: A small step in a project, with an assignee and a due date.
space.coldStart.view: See tasks as a Board or a List.
project.askManager: Ask the space's manager to create a project.
board.sr.picked: Picked up {0}. Move it with the mouse, or press Escape to cancel.
board.sr.instructions: Drag with the mouse. With the keyboard, press Space on a card and choose a column.
preset.startDescription: An example project to try Board and List.
bulk.skippedComplete: {0} tasks skipped because you can only view them.
bulk.skippedAssign: {0} tasks skipped: you can only view them, or the assignee has no access to their project.
icon.hint: PNG, SVG, JPG or WebP, square, up to 1 MB.
icon.tooLarge: The icon can be at most 1 MB.
icon.badType: Format not supported. Use PNG, SVG, JPG or WebP.
members.title: Members {0}
members.lead: People who can open this project. The numbers count tasks in this project; access is set in Share.
members.col.name: Name
onboarding.preset.title: Where do you want to start?
onboarding.preset.lead: Pick a starting point. Everything can be changed, and the Start here project is always included.
onboarding.invite.title: Invite your team
onboarding.invite.lead: They get an email to join. You can also invite people later from Desk.
onboarding.done.title: {0} is ready
onboarding.done.inviteLater: You can invite your team any time from Desk
project.accessEveryoneHint: Every member of the organization can open this project.
project.accessRestrictedHint: Only the people and teams listed in Share can open this project.
project.accessSpaceHint: This project follows its space's access, plus anyone added in Share.
share.privateLinkHint: Only for people who already have access
share.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Copy it from the address bar.
share.projectNarrower: A project cannot be more open than its space.
share.audited: Changes are recorded in the audit log
share.advancedHintSpace: Who can open this space, and at which level.
share.advancedHintProject: Who can open this project, and at which level.
share.onlyYou: Only you can access. Add people or teams.
share.inheritNoteSpace: Projects in this space follow this access, unless a project is restricted on its own.
share.inheritNoteProject: Tasks and boards in this project follow this access.
share.lastManager: At least one person must be able to manage.
status.title: Project status
status.label: Status
status.ownerHint: Must be able to edit the project.
status.ownerNoAccess: This person cannot edit the project yet. Share it first.
summary.overdueHint: Open and past the due date
trash.lead: Deleted spaces, projects and tasks stay here for 30 days, then they are removed for good.
trash.emptyBody: Items you can manage appear here after they are deleted.
trash.nameTaken: Another space already uses this name. Rename that space first.
trash.parentDeleted: Its space or project is in Trash too. Restore that first.
email.suspended.subject: Your access to {0} is suspended
email.suspended.body:
Hi {0},

An Owner or Admin of {1} suspended your access. Your work stays in the organization. Contact them if you think this is a mistake.
email.reactivated.subject: Your access to {0} is back
email.reactivated.body:
Hi {0},

You can work in {1} again. Sign in to continue.
email.removed.subject: Your access to {0} has ended
email.removed.body:
Hi {0},

You are no longer a member of {1}. Your account and your other organizations are not affected.
email.orgDeletion.subject: {0} is scheduled for deletion
email.orgDeletion.body:
Hi {0},

{1} scheduled {4} for deletion. It will be deleted permanently on {2}, with all its spaces, projects and tasks.

An Owner can cancel before then in Kelola › Umum:
{3}
email.passwordChanged.subject: Your agere/org password was changed
email.locked.subject: Sign-in to your agere/org account is paused
email.linked.subject: A sign-in method was added to your account
email.linked.body:
Hi {0},

A new sign-in method was linked to your agere/org account. Not you? Reset your password and contact support.
email.unlinked.subject: A sign-in method was removed from your account
email.unlinked.body:
Hi {0},

A sign-in method was removed from your agere/org account. Not you? Reset your password and contact support.
email.mfa.subject: Two-step verification changed
email.mfa.body:
Hi {0},

The two-step verification of your agere/org account changed. Not you? Reset your password and contact support.
email.deletionRequested.subject: We received your account deletion request
email.deletionRequested.body:
Hi {0},

We received your request to delete your agere/org account. Your personal data is deleted within 30 days.
notif.work_reassigned: {0} tasks from {1} were handed to you
inbox.coldStart.title: Your work news shows up here
inbox.coldStart.body: Kotak masuk collects news from your work, so you don't have to look for it.
inbox.coldStart.assigned: When someone gives you a task.
inbox.coldStart.mention: When someone mentions you in a comment.
inbox.coldStart.due: When your tasks are due today.
inbox.missingBody: This item was deleted or you do not have access.
welcome.title: Welcome to {0}
welcome.body: Three steps to get your team going. You can close this card any time.
settings.title: Account settings
settings.personalHint: Applies only to your account, in every organization.
settings.saveFailed: Your changes were not saved. Try again.
settings.photoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. We crop it to a square.
settings.avatarInvalid: The photo can be at most 2 MB. Use PNG, JPG or WebP.
settings.jobTitleHint: Optional. Shown on your member profile, e.g. Senior designer.
settings.emailHint: Your sign-in email cannot be changed here yet.
settings.changePasswordHint: Your other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in.
settings.wrongPassword: The current password is not right.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.devicesHint: Where your account is signed in right now.
settings.signOutAllBody: Every device, including this one, is signed out. You will need to sign in again.
settings.activityEmpty: No security activity in the last 30 days.
settings.themeHint: Only your view changes; other members see no difference.
settings.timezoneHint: Decides "Today", due dates and the 08.00 reminder in every organization.
settings.languageHint: Changes the app, notifications and emails for you. Content others write stays as written.
settings.myDataHint: Download your profile, memberships, tasks and comments as a JSON file.
settings.deleteAccountHint: You are signed out everywhere at once. Your name, email and photo are erased within 30 days; your work stays in the organizations as "Deleted user".
settings.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. You will be asked for your password.
settings.leaveFirst: Leave the {0} organizations below before deleting your account.
settings.leaveBody: Your open tasks there are handed to an Owner. You need a new invitation to come back.
settings.soleOwner: You are the only Owner. Transfer ownership first.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.panel: Hide or show the side panel
settings.deletedNotice: Your account is being deleted. We sent a confirmation to your email.
